claims.claim: Diners Club routes cardholder support to the local franchise issuer rather than a central network desk; the network help center is a country-selector.
claims.quote: To contact customer service for your Diners Club card, please reach out to your local issuer from our Support Center.
claims.title: Help Center
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Support: no central hours, phone, language or SLA published on the network site; support is per-franchise. Chrome/Edge-only India ODR tool at odr.dinersclub.com also linked.

claims.claim: The network homepage frames support and account servicing as a per-country Club model.
claims.quote: To find out more about your account or see what your local Club has to offer, choose your country.
claims.title: Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footer links partners to discoverglobalnetwork.com, pulsenetwork.com and developer.discover.com (Dev Center).

claims.claim: Business partner enquiries from the Diners Club business page are routed to the shared Discover Global Network service-center contact form rather than a Diners-specific channel.
claims.quote: We work with partners around the world to bring our card offerings to your business.
claims.title: Businesses
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: CONTACT US links to https://servicecenter.discoverglobalnetwork.com/onlineform/contact-us. No account-management model, SLA or hours stated.

claims.claim: Current Diners Club issuers get assets and tools through a ServiceNow-hosted issuer portal that is restricted to existing issuers.
claims.quote: Access assets, resources and tools available to you as a current issuer
claims.title: Get Started - Payments Providers
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Portal at discover.service-now.com/infonet; page says available to current Diners Club International Issuers only.

claims.claim: Operational support for acquirers and processors runs through the EASI portal, which includes a Message Center to reach the Discover Global Network operations team.
claims.title: Get Started - Payments Providers
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: EASI = Enablement, Acceptance Support Info-center; holds enablement materials, tech specs, developer test card kits. No response-time SLA stated.

claims.claim: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services, parent of Diners Club International, effective May 18, 2025.
claims.quote: Capital One Financial Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“Capital One” or the “Company”), completed its previously announced acquisition of Discover Financial Services
claims.title: Form 8-K, Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Merger Agreement dated Feb 19, 2024; exchange ratio 1.0192. Ownership event for Diners Club, Discover Network and PULSE.

claims.claim: Nium launched a Diners Club International virtual card for B2B travel payments, making it an issuer across four schemes (Visa, Mastercard, UATP, Discover).
claims.quote: our ability to issue virtual cards across four of the world's leading payment schemes gives our customers unparalleled global access
claims.title: Nium Launches Diners Club International Card to Expand B2B Payments for Travel Industry
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Predates Capital One close. Quote is Nium's Mark Anthony Spiteri; Matt Sloan quoted as VP International Markets EMEA at Discover.

claims.claim: Pax2pay, a UK virtual card issuer, signed a strategic agreement with Diners Club International for travel-sector virtual cards.
claims.quote: Working with Pax2pay marks a new chapter for Diners Club International as we continue to grow in the travel sector.
claims.title: Pax2pay Partners with Diners Club International to Drive Growth in Travel Payments
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Predates Capital One close. Quote attributed to Matt Sloan, VP of Business Development EMEA.

claims.claim: BRAC Bank (Bangladesh) launched the Diners Club Emerald credit card for corporate professionals with Discover Network's APAC team quoted.
claims.quote: The Diners Club Emerald Card brings together two trusted brands to enhance the banking experience.
claims.title: BRAC Bank collaborates with Diners Club International to launch Emerald Credit Card
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Post-close (Capital One not mentioned). Quote is Chris Winter, VP International Markets APAC, Discover Network.

claims.claim: Moorwand extended its Diners Club relationship from issuing to UK merchant acquiring, enabling acceptance of Discover, Diners Club and network-alliance cards.
claims.quote: By adding acquiring to our collaboration, we're empowering UK businesses with more ways to grow and serve a global customer base
claims.title: Moorwand Ltd Expands Its Collaboration with Diners Club International to Include Acquiring
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Quote is John Vlassiou, COO, Moorwand. Page cites 30 network alliance partner cards.

claims.claim: UZCARD and Discover Network announced a strategic alliance giving Discover and Diners Club cardholders POS and ATM acceptance across Uzbekistan.
claims.quote: Cardholders of Discover Network and Diners Club International can now make purchases and withdraw cash across a broad network of POS terminals and ATMs
claims.title: UZCARD and Discover Network Announce Strategic Alliance to Expand Global Payment Access in Uzbekistan
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Cites 378+ million cards, 190+ countries. Matt Sloan quoted as VP International Markets at Discover.

claims.claim: Sparkasse Pay launched a co-badged Diners Club International / Mastercard credit card in Slovenia.
claims.quote: use a single card at Diners Club International and Mastercard acceptance points both in Slovenia and worldwide
claims.title: Sparkasse Pay introduces a new credit card combining the best of Diners Club International and Mastercard
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Will Cross quoted for Diners Club International; Mastercard Slovenia director also quoted. Example of co-badge issuing model.

claims.claim: Diners Club hosted the 2026 DCI Pro-Am Classic at Costa Navarino, Greece, the network's recurring hospitality event.
claims.quote: tournament play alongside curated dining, social events, and destination experiences
claims.title: Diners Club Hosts the 2026 Pro-Am Classic
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Events: page does not say whether franchisees or issuers attend; a 2025 edition was also posted. No partner training or academy found.

claims.claim: ISX Financial launched the flykk Diners Club International debit card in EU and UK priority markets, positioning Diners as an issuing scheme for fintech wallets.
claims.quote: we strive to offer users an unparalleled payment experience both online and in store
claims.title: ISX Financial and Diners Club International Launch flykk Debit Card: A New Era of Global Payments
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Quote is Nikogiannis Karantzis, CEO ISX Financial. Matt Sloan quoted as VP international markets EMEA, Discover Global Network. Boilerplate: over 25 alliance partners, 345 million cardholders.

claims.claim: Diners Club describes itself through Discover Global Network boilerplate as the fastest-growing global network measured by alliance count.
claims.quote: the fastest growing global payments network by number of network alliances
claims.title: ISX Financial and Diners Club International Launch flykk Debit Card: A New Era of Global Payments
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Marketing claim; no third-party corroboration fetched.

claims.claim: Diners Club marked its 75th anniversary with a transaction-linked donation programme to World Central Kitchen, funded per card purchase.
claims.quote: donated $750,000 to World Central Kitchen. Every transaction provided a meal
claims.title: Diners Club International Marks 75th Anniversary with Donation to World Central Kitchen
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Quote seen in the Club Connections listing excerpt; listing showed '4 months ago' (approx. May 2026). Article itself not opened.
